description: Provenance of every skill in data/skills/ after Sub-Phase 7.3. type 'fetched' means the bytes came from the public URL in this file; type 'excluded' means the source was fetched and inspected but deliberately not imported. Every count below the attribution block is written by scripts/assemble-corpus.mjs from the run, not by hand.
selection: The sub-phase asked for at least 200 skills. 465 real skills across eleven MIT sources pass the corpus validator; the first 200 of them were taken ROUND ROBIN, one per source per pass, in the order the sources are listed below. Filling the cap source-by-source instead would have given 162 of the 200 slots to a single repository and left eight sources contributing nothing. The rule is fixed before any retrieval runs and never looks at a ranking. 265 further valid skills were left out and are reproducible from the manifest named in each source entry; docs/reports/phase-7.3-corpus-build.md records what importing all of them would have cost.

policy.allow: A fetched skill is repaired only by a mechanical rename to the {domain}-{specific} shape (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs to a single hyphen). Nothing else is edited.
policy.forbid: A description is never written, truncated or padded, and no body is touched. A fetched skill that has no description, or a description outside 40-400 characters, is dropped, not fixed.
policy.drop_rule: A fetched skill that still fails `node bin/skill-router.mjs corpus validate` after the allowed rename is dropped. The re-fetch alternative is not used because the manifests in tmp/ are the fetch of record and a second fetch of the same commit would return the same bytes.
policy.staging: Only SKILL.md is kept, so the number of files under the corpus directory equals the number of index entries. The 7.2 importer copies whole skill directories; scripts/assemble-corpus.mjs narrows them first.
